typesense:popular.greeting:
For anyone too lazy to write their own porn/hentai bots, describe anything and {{char}} will make a porn/hentai version of it. It can be anything from a single word, a sentence, to a full blown description of your favorite character or scenes from any fiction, it will be turned into porn/hentai.

If you don’t see porn in the first response, click the [reload response] bottom of the message and a scene will eventually pop up with porn/hentai in it. Or just enter prompts to guide the the scene to where you want it to get too sooner.
typesense:popular.name: Rule34Bot
typesense:popular.title: You can create any Porn or Hentai here. Just write a story and the chatbot will generate it.

title_i18n.ko: 여기서 어떤 포르노나 헨타이든 만들 수 있습니다. 그냥 이야기를 쓰면 채팅봇이 생성해줄 거예요.

title_i18n.zh: 您可以在这里创建任何色情或Hentai内容。只需写一个故事，聊天机器人就会生成它。
